global: This is a bowl of miso ramen with a rich, orange-brown broth. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and chopped green onions, it sits in a white bowl on a dark tray, under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and slight sheen, showing natural texture and warm brown tones.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly uneven rim with minor residue stains.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich orange-red, glossy surface with visible noodles and toppings, slightly uneven texture.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded tip.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show browned, tender texture with visible fat marbling and green onion garnish on surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, golden-brown, with curled, layered texture and glossy surface from broth.
